definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:408-436, the Definition displays ax_prodnorm/ax_assoc/ax_*/ax_C*/ax_eps_unit/ax_exact_unit): ||XY|| <= (1+\eps)||X|| ||Y||; ||(XY)Z-X(YZ)|| <= \eps ||X|| ||Y|| ||Z||; involution: ||X^\dag||=||X||, (XY)^\dag=Y^\dag X^\dag; C*-bound: ||X^\dag X|| >= (1-\eps)||X||^2 (upper bound (1+\eps)||X||^2 follows); unital: ||XI-X|| <= \eps||X||, ||IX-X|| <= \eps||X||, | ||I||-1 | <= \eps (default) or exact XI=X, IX=X, ||I||=1 (if specified); I^\dag=I.
